explication: Kelivo is a cross-platform Flutter LLM client. Its primary workflow is to configure a model provider, start a conversation, and optionally let the model use search, tools, memory, or a bound workspace before returning a result. The README documents those product stages and local-first storage; the supplied tree and excerpts mainly expose native platform services, not the Flutter/Dart implementation, so undocumented internal links are omitted. Native code shown supports background generation, scheduled tasks, device tools, and incoming-share handling.
